notes.title: V0.2.0 Coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello! 

I just want to let everyone know that a new version is coming with lots of fixes and goodies. Also the new workshop feature is coming on this update which I think it's going to be a game changer.

I do want to warn the users, that this update will most likely wipe out your saved sounds. I improved some stuff on loading and saving sound effects and images, which means I changed the way I did some things previously. I truly apologize this and I hope you understand this app is still going through the development process.

Thank you for using this app, all the feedback I've been receiving has been great and lots of new ideas are coming up.

notes.title: StreamPad v0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
New features:

+ Auto save data
+ Unlimited slots
+ Settings menu
+ Dark Mode
+ Reset All Data
+ Addition of Japanese and Russian languages
